question: The correct chemical-formula of washing soda is:
solution:
The correct answer is** __Na2CO3.10H2​O__.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The scientific formula for Washing Soda is **Na2CO3.10H2​O.**
 
• Its full name is **Sodium Carbonate decahydrate**.
 
• Here **H₂O** is the water molecule attached to it.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is used in **removing stains**.
 
• It is used in **removing the permanent hardness of the water.**
 
• It is used in **the manufacturing of soap, paper as well as glass**. 
 
• It is also used in **textiles and petroleum refining.**

5a:T
